// note: Canonical MCP server definitions. ai.sh auto-registers only the lean always-on set (filesystem, context7). Everything else is opt-in via `mcp-toggle <name> on|off` (or `/mcp`) so the per-turn schema cost stays low — each heavy server adds 2k–10k context tokens every turn. github is opt-in because the `gh` CLI covers routine work; composio is registered by ai.sh only when COMPOSIO_API_KEY is set. Secrets come from env (~/.env), never inline.

github.// note: Opt-in (heavy schema, re-sent every turn). Enable with `github-on` / `mcp-toggle github on` when you need GitHub tools beyond the gh CLI.

context7.// note: Up-to-date, version-correct library docs into context. Low overhead. CONTEXT7_API_KEY is optional (raises rate limits).

composio.// note: Opt-in: 300+ SaaS/API connectors. Heavy on context tokens — registered by ai.sh only when COMPOSIO_API_KEY is set. Verify the start command against the current composio CLI.

linear.// note: Opt-in. Official Linear MCP (hosted, HTTP + OAuth — no API key). Enable with `linear-on`, then authenticate once via `/mcp` in a Claude session.

dropbox.// note: Opt-in. Official Dropbox MCP (hosted, HTTP + OAuth, open beta). Browse/search/read/move/share files, Sign, Paper. Cannot create developer apps or API keys. Enable with `mcp-toggle dropbox on`, then authenticate once via `/mcp`.

huggingface.// note: Opt-in. Official Hugging Face MCP (hosted, HTTP + OAuth via ?login). Hub/Spaces/docs search + repo writes. hf CLI already covers deploys. Enable with `mcp-toggle huggingface on`, then authenticate once via `/mcp`.

trello.// note: Opt-in. Official Trello MCP (hosted, HTTP + OAuth — no API key). Boards, lists, cards, checklists, search. Enable with `trello-on`, then authenticate once via `/mcp` in a Claude session.

playwright.// note: Opt-in (heavy: ~13.7k tool-def tokens at startup). Prefer the Agent Browser / Playwright CLI instead; enable with `browser-on` only when you need interactive MCP control.

chrome-devtools.// note: Opt-in. Network/console/performance/DOM debugging via CDP. Enable with `browser-on` when diagnosing runtime issues.

code-review-graph.// note: Opt-in. Local-first code-intelligence graph (Tree-sitter AST + caller/dependent/test edges) exposing ~30 review tools over MCP so an agent reads only what a diff touches. Installed by fresh.sh (`uv tool install code-review-graph`). Run `code-review-graph build` once per repo before enabling. Enable with `review-on`, disable with `review-off`. Reads the graph relative to the cwd, so toggle it on from inside the target project.

cloudflare.// note: Opt-in. Official Cloudflare API MCP (hosted, HTTP + OAuth, no API token). Whole Cloudflare API (Pages, Workers, DNS, R2, D1) via search() and execute(). Enable with `mcp-toggle cloudflare on`, then authenticate once via `/mcp`.

godaddy.// note: Official GoDaddy MCP (hosted, HTTP, no auth). Domain search only: check_domain_availability, suggest_domains. Cannot edit DNS. Enable with `mcp-toggle godaddy on`.

circleci.// note: Official CircleCI hosted MCP (HTTP, OAuth2 via /mcp > circleci > Authenticate; nothing installed locally). Build failure logs, pipeline status, rerun. Enable with `mcp-toggle circleci on`.
